source.title: Berkeley Municipal Code ch. 23.328 (gocodebook.com mirror)
source.note: berkeley.municipal.codes blocks automated access; verify against the official code before citing.

percentOfUnits.quote: unless at least 20% of the Residential Units are Affordable Units

rounding.quote: When the calculation results in a fractional unit, an Applicant will round up to the nearest whole unit

veryLowShareOfRequired.quote: At least 50% of the required Affordable Units in the Housing Development Project shall be offered at a rent that is affordable to Very Low Income Households
